overall: The AG found no violation because the chair's emailed distribution of a composite evaluation for an open meeting was an exempt administrative task; the April 2018 notice says the SJC's Boelter decision supersedes this reasoning to the extent inconsistent.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly deliberated on the town administrator's professional competence through written communications before a March 2012 open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: By performing this administrative task by email, Chair Fay did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
